claims.claim_text: American Express 把支付平台重構成 cell-based 架構：系統切成多個彼此獨立、不互相依賴的 cell，每筆交易在單一 cell 內完成，故障的爆炸半徑被關進那個 cell。
claims.evidence: Each cell is able to function independently without reliance on other cells. ... Is a single failure domain, meaning that if one cell experiences issues, it doesn't cascade the failure beyond the cell boundary.

claims.claim_text: 靜態資料事先複製到每個 cell，動態資料靠 Global Transaction Router 做決定性路由；cell 掛掉時在途交易改派到健康的 cell 重啟而非續跑，靠交易 id 維持冪等。
claims.evidence: we pre-populate this data in each cell ahead of time. ... the Global Transaction Router also serves as a payments mesh ... we restart transaction processing in another cell with the original transaction data. ... Each transaction carries a unique transaction identifier that remains consistent across retries and reroutes.

claims.claim_text: xeiaso 想把 wasm2js 打包進 Anubis，讓 client 與 server 跑同一份 PoW 驗證邏輯，撞進編譯器不確定性：同樣輸入位元組，bytecode 卻不一樣。
claims.evidence: the check logic is defined in one place on both client and server ... If you have the same bytes of input to a compiler, you should get the same bytes of output ... lol you'd think, but no, it's not.

claims.claim_text: 元兇之一是 clang 偷偷從 $PATH 抓 wasm-opt，v108 與 v130 行為不一致；解法是 --no-wasm-opt，再用 setarch --addr-no-randomize、為 x86_64 與 ARM64 各算一份 checksum。
claims.evidence: clang shells out to wasm-opt when doing builds ... The solution was to pass --no-wasm-opt at the linking step. ... Disable address-space randomization for this build using setarch --addr-no-randomize. ... Create known good sha256 checksums for both x86_64 and arm64
claims.note: wasm-opt shell-out、--no-wasm-opt、setarch、per-arch checksum 皆逐字確認；v108/v130 版本機制獲支持。

claims.claim_text: VDH 八階段流水線把 20,799 個原始候選篩到 12,057 個，再交給用不同模型的 VVS 二次裁決，最後送出 7,245 個可行動的發現。
claims.evidence: Out of 20,799 raw candidates generated by VDH, only about 12,057 survived validation ... we use a completely different model for VVS ... this left 7,245 actionable findings for engineering teams
claims.note: 三個數字與 different-model 皆逐字確認。

claims.claim_text: 負責反證的 validator 不能自己提報、只能推翻 hunter。
claims.evidence: This Validator cannot log findings of its own; its sole job is to aggressively disprove the Hunter's theory

claims.claim_text: Chrome 對 Manifest V2 的拔除進入末章：Chromium 150–151 會移除原本讓使用者繞過 MV2 退場的旗標。
claims.evidence: 看起來 Manifest V2 (MV2) 要進入到末章了 ... Chromium 150 lost ExtensionManifestV2Disabled option ... Chromium 151 will loose ExtensionManifestV2Unsupported option ... AllowLegacyMV2Extensions
claims.note: 末章與 150-151 旗標移除確認；MV3 webRequest 限制非載重句。

claims.claim_text: npm v12 打算把 post-install script 預設關掉，跟上 pnpm 與 Bun 早就採取的做法。
claims.evidence: npm v12 預設要關掉 post install script 了 ... 像是 pnpm 的「Mitigating supply chain attacks」，或是 Bun 的「Add a trusted dependency」
claims.note: npm v12 default-off 與 pnpm/Bun 先例確認。

claims.claim_text: AWS 推出 Graviton5，宣稱對比 Graviton4 有 25–35% 效能提升，L3 cache 加到五倍、上 PCIe Gen6、拉高記憶體頻寬。
claims.evidence: Graviton5 offers up to 25% better compute performance compared to Graviton4-based instances, with up to 35% faster performance for web applications ... 5 times more L3 cache compared to the previous generation ... PCIe Gen6 and DDR5-8800 memory
claims.note: 原稿誤寫『六倍』；來源為 5 times more L3 cache。已將 lede 改為『五倍』以對齊來源。

claims.claim_text: MiniMax 釋出 M3：428B 總參數、約 23B 啟動的 MoE 模型，原生多模態、支援 1M token context。
claims.evidence: MiniMax-M3 is a native multimodal model with 1M context. It has ~428B parameters and ~23B activated parameters.

claims.claim_text: 賣點是 MiniMax Sparse Attention（MSA），號稱 1M context 下比 M2 拿到 9× prefill、15× decode 的加速。
claims.evidence: M3 delivers 9x prefill and 15x decode speedups compared to M2 at 1M context
claims.note: lede 用『號稱』對應廠商自報數字。

claims.claim_text: NGINX Ingress Controller 5.5 讓 External Authentication 同時支援 Ingress 與 VirtualServer 兩種資源；同版把 ingress/egress 的 mTLS 帶到 Ingress 資源上，並改善大量資源下的啟動時間。
claims.evidence: External Authentication is now supported for both Ingress and VirtualServer resources. ... Mutual TLS for ingress and egress traffic is now supported on the Ingress resource. ... NIC startup time has been significantly improved for environments with large numbers of configured resources.
claims.note: 原稿宣稱『收斂成一條 ExternalAuth policy／在 Policy 資源定義一次／CRD mTLS policy』，來源未如此表述（唯一的 Policy 資源是 WAF）。已改寫 lede 與 H2 為來源原意：ExternalAuth 同時支援兩種資源、mTLS 在 Ingress 資源上、啟動時間改善。

claims.claim_text: 同版針對設定大量資源的環境改善啟動時間。
claims.evidence: NIC startup time has been significantly improved for environments with large numbers of configured resources.

claims.claim_text: 有人對 RTK 這類壓縮終端輸出省 token 的工具潑冷水：廣告打的 60–90% 節省只算終端輸出；壓縮是靜默降級，模型不知道自己少看了關鍵除錯資訊。
claims.evidence: That viral '60-90% savings' statistic is deeply misleading. ... the heaviest cost drivers: deep file reads, repository contexts, system prompts ... the AI agent has no idea the text was compressed.
claims.note: 60-90%、成本錯置、靜默降級皆逐字確認。

claims.claim_text: 他主張這種優化該做成 CLI 原生的 --compact，而不是塞進 agent 與 shell 之間的脆弱外掛。
claims.evidence: Mainstream CLIs and developer tools can easily ship a native --compact or --json-stream flag tailored for LLM consumption.

claims.claim_text: Ubiquiti 推出建在 ZFS 上的企業級 NAS，把 ZFS 的快照與資料完整性帶進整合式硬體生態。
claims.evidence: Combines proven ZFS architecture ... Native ZFS for advanced storage protection ... Integrated snapshot capabilities
claims.note: ZFS NAS、快照、資料保護皆獲支持。
